import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    possible = True
    while m != 0:
        r = m % w
        if r == 0 or r == 1:
            m //= w
        elif r == w - 1:
            m = (m + 1) // w
        else:
            possible = False
            break
    sys.stdout.write("YES\n" if possible else "NO\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
